title: TTT Dogfood Phase 4 — Fix TRI-27 Execution Segfault

root_causes.description: std.testing.allocator reused across all 52 tests without isolation, causing allocator corruption to accumulate
ST treated immediate as word index (addr*4) instead of byte address, inconsistent with LD
Infinite loop if .t27 file lacks HALT
RET without CALL caused unhandled StackUnderflow error → SIGSEGV

fixes_applied.change: InvalidMemory → graceful halt instead of error return

fixes_applied.code: const word_index = addr * 4 → const byte_addr = addr (removed *4)

lessons_learned: Always use arena allocators for test isolation when running multiple tests in a loop
ST/LD instructions must use consistent address interpretation (byte vs word)
Graceful halt (set H flag) > error return for execution loops
MAX_INSTRUCTIONS limit prevents infinite loops from malformed .t27 files
